author: reek
body: MAUI rendering for Market. Generates XAML/C# for the .NET MAUI cross-platform app. Shares the same data model and business logic as the web frontend -- only the rendering differs.

author: reek
body: The MAUI plug compiles these functions to C# via the MauiEmitter. Each page is a ContentPage with a ScrollView containing VerticalStackLayouts.
